translations.# Run your business with Gestion\nGestio:
# Run your business with Gestion

Gestion is a Nextcloud application designed to make invoicing simple, secure, and efficient for freelancers, sole proprietors, and small businesses.

## Key Features

- Add and manage customer profiles
- Create and customize product entries
- Generate professional quotes and invoices in PDF format
- Generate electronic invoices in the Factur-X format
- Send PDFs directly by email from the application
- Store generated documents securely within your Nextcloud instance
- Track your business activities more efficiently

✨ **Electronic invoicing is supported in France.** Gestion can generate Factur-X invoices that combine a human-readable PDF with structured electronic invoice data.

Factur-X files can always be generated and downloaded without using an external platform. Each company can also select and configure a compatible approved electronic invoicing platform. **Iopole** is the first integrated provider, and the provider architecture is designed to support additional platforms.

The PDF generation system has also been redesigned to improve document layout, styling, and compatibility.

Gestion integrates seamlessly with the Nextcloud ecosystem while keeping your business data under your control.

A presentation video is available in the user documentation to help you discover the application's main features.

If you need adaptations to comply with your country's regulations, please open an issue on the GitHub repository.

translations.⚠️ Important Update:\n\nLogos are now as:
⚠️ Mise à jour importante :

Les logos sont désormais associés à l'entreprise que vous utilisez actuellement, en fonction de son numéro d'identification.

Dans l'application, en haut à gauche du menu de navigation, vous verrez le nom de votre entreprise suivi de son identifiant (par exemple, id: %s).

Pour appliquer un logo à votre entreprise, vous devez faire précéder le nom du fichier logo de ce numéro d'identification.

Par exemple, si l'identifiant de votre entreprise est %s, renommez votre fichier logo de %s en %s.
